AdminMember.title: AdminMember
AdminMember.description: Authorized administrator granted access to create and manage Teachers' Day 20/11 greeting cards.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the collaborator admin.

email.description: Verified email address of the collaborator admin.

displayName.description: Display name of the collaborator admin.

addedBy.description: UID of the superadmin who added this collaborator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

TeacherCard.title: TeacherCard
TeacherCard.description: Personalized Vietnamese Teachers' Day (20/11) ceremonial lacquer greeting card.

honorific.description: Ceremonial greeting prefix such as 'Kính tặng Cô' or 'Kính tặng Thầy'.

teacherName.description: Full name of the honored teacher.

roleOrSubject.description: Subject taught, class, or academic title.

photoData.description: Compressed image data URI or HTTPS URL of the teacher's portrait.

message.description: Heartfelt tribute letter written for the teacher.

senderName.description: Name of the class, student group, or sender.

yearLabel.description: Commemorative date label displayed on the card.

musicTheme.description: Selected commemorative melody played when opening the card.

customAudioUrl.description: Optional external HTTPS audio URL when musicTheme is 'custom'.

lacquerStyle.description: Lacquerware visual palette variant for the card.

ownerUid.description: UID of the admin who created this card.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Collaborator admin registry keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/cards/{cardId}.description: Individual 20/11 greeting cards addressed by shareable slug ID.
